styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.MAKSOE: a sturdy middle-aged workman with black hair tied in a small topknot and a gray headband, a sooty weathered face, in coarse gray hemp clothes — not a monk, never bald
characters.HYEUN: a very old bald monk with a long white beard in a plain gray robe
characters.SANGJWA: a middle-aged bald monk in a gray robe
characters.OFFICER: a stern middle-aged official with a short beard in a dark blue robe and black gat

scenes.S01: [WEB] Extreme close-up before dawn at a temple kitchen furnace: only two soot-blackened hands feeding pine branches into a glowing fire, orange firelight on the knuckles. No faces, nobody else, dark plain background.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene in a Korean temple courtyard at dawn, two clear roles: 1. CENTER, standing in soot-stained work clothes with a bundle of firewood at his feet: MAKSOE. 2. AROUND HIM, several monks in gray robes bowing deeply toward him. Old pine trees and a tiled temple hall behind.
scenes.S05: A Korean mountain temple at dawn: tiled roofs among pine trees, morning mist in the valley, a stone staircase leading up, a small bell pavilion. No people.
scenes.S06: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE crouching in front of a big stone furnace in a temple kitchen, pushing firewood into the fire, his face and hands smudged with soot, steam rising from a huge iron pot.
scenes.S07: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE climbing a snowy mountain path with a huge load of firewood on an A-frame carrier on his back, breath white in the cold, bare trees around him.
scenes.S08: A temple courtyard: three young Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. walking past and glancing sideways with faint smirks at MAKSOE, who stands aside holding a water bucket with his head lowered.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain temple, black silhouettes of tiled roofs and pine trees, one thin line of smoke rising from the kitchen chimney into gold and orange clouds.
scenes.S10: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE standing in a dim temple kitchen doorway at evening, looking out toward the lit main hall, his hands black with soot, a faint longing on his face. Plain empty paper background, no signboard, no letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S11: Exactly two people at night before a kitchen furnace: HYEUN sitting on a low stool and MAKSOE crouching beside him, both looking into the fire, warm orange light on their faces.
scenes.S12: Exactly two people: MAKSOE holding his rough hands toward the fire while speaking, and HYEUN listening with a warm nod, firelight between them.
scenes.S14: Exactly two people in a dim temple kitchen: HYEUN placing a small wooden moktak into the soot-blackened hands of MAKSOE, who looks down at it in surprise.
scenes.S15: [WEB] No people: a growing stack of small plain wooden tally sticks (flat hand-sized pieces of wood with simple scratched lines, not boxes) in the corner of a dim temple kitchen behind the furnace, warm firelight.
scenes.S16: Several officials in dark robes and black gat standing sternly in a temple courtyard with a scroll in hand, monks gathered before them looking worried, tiled temple hall behind.
scenes.S17: Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. sitting in rows inside a dim temple hall with grim faces, one elder speaking, candlelight on the wooden floor.
scenes.S18: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain temple with its gate closed, black silhouettes of a few figures walking down the stone stairs away from it, layered gray and gold clouds.
scenes.S19: HYEUN lying on a thin mat in a small temple room, pale and weak, two young Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. kneeling beside him, an oil lamp on the floor.
scenes.S20: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE sitting alone on the wooden veranda outside a closed paper door at night, hands on his knees, snow on the railing, a lantern beside him.
scenes.S22: HYEUN propped up on a mat, holding a brush over a blank sheet of paper with a trembling hand, a young monk with a shaven head holding the ink stone, lamplight in a small room. Nothing written on the paper.
scenes.S23: [SIL] Snowy night over a mountain temple, black silhouettes of roofs and pines, one paper window glowing warm yellow, a thin line of smoke from the chimney.
scenes.S24: Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. and two officials in dark robes gathered in a temple hall, SANGJWA carefully opening a sealed envelope, everyone leaning in, daylight through paper windows.
scenes.S25: Only one person in the picture: a middle-aged head monk in gray robes standing and reading a sheet of paper, his eyes wide and his mouth slightly open in shock. Plain background, no letters visible.
scenes.S26: Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. and officials in a temple hall reacting in surprise, several talking to each other, one official frowning at a sheet of paper, daylight.
scenes.S27: [WEB] Scene inside a temple kitchen: monks and officials crowding in the doorway, staring at a whole wall stacked from floor to ceiling with thousands of small hand-carved wooden blocks. MAKSOE stands quietly beside the furnace in soot-stained clothes.
scenes.S28: [WEB] Close-up of a monk's hands holding a few small plain wooden tally sticks covered with scratched tally lines, more sticks stacked behind. Nothing written, plain background.
scenes.S30: SANGJWA reading from a sheet of paper in a temple hall, Buddhist monks with clean-shaven bald heads and no hats, in plain gray monk robes — not noblemen, no black gat, no topknot. around him lowering their heads, some with tears, daylight through paper windows.
scenes.S31: Exactly two people: OFFICER holding up one small plain wooden tally stick and studying it, MAKSOE standing quietly behind him. Temple kitchen, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S32: [WEB] Scene in a temple courtyard in the morning: MAKSOE standing awkwardly in soot-stained work clothes with a bundle of firewood at his feet, and a dozen monks in gray robes bowing deeply to him in two rows. Pine trees and tiled hall behind.
scenes.S34: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE crouching at the kitchen furnace, feeding firewood into the fire with a calm face. Completely plain background, no sign, no plaque, no letters, no calligraphy anywhere.
scenes.S35: MAKSOE showing two young bald monks in gray robes how to stack firewood in a kitchen furnace, all three crouching, warm firelight, steam from a big iron pot.
scenes.S36: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE sitting alone on a wooden doorstep at dusk, holding a small wooden moktak in both hands, eyes closed with a peaceful face. Behind him only pine trees and evening sky — no wall, no signboard, no letters.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Full moon over a mountain temple at night, black silhouettes of tiled roofs and pines, one thin line of smoke rising from the kitchen chimney, layered silver clouds and a gold band.
